events.title: U.S. Dollar Slides As Crude Oil Nosedives Following Democrats' Win In Mid-term Elections
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value moved lower on Wednesday as concerns of escalation in the U.S.-Iran conflict diminished after the mid-term election results showed a huge win for Democrats who seized control of both the houses in the U.S. Congress. As markets are betting on an end to the war, inflation worries faded and crude oil prices nosedived by nearly 8.00%.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends On Upbeat Note
events.description:
After opening on a somewhat cautious note Wednesday morning, the Switzerland stock market recovered and then kept climbing higher and higher as the day progressed to eventually settle on an upbeat note.

Positive global markets amid easing trade and inflation concerns rendered the mood in the Swiss market quite bullish.

events.title: European Stocks Jump On Earnings, Oil's Plunge, U.S. Midterm Election Results
events.description: European stocks climbed sharply Wednesday as Democratic election victories, better-than-expected corporate earnings, and falling oil prices boosted investor sentiment across major exchanges.

events.title: TSX Up Sharply As Investors React To Earnings, U.S. Midterm Election Outcome
events.description: The Canadian market is up firmly in positive territory Wednesday morning with the benchmark S&P/TSX Composite surging 1.7%. The mood in the market is quite positive amid hopes of easing trade tensions between Canada and the U.S., following the Democrats regaining control of both chambers of Congress in the US, defeating the Republicans in the midterm polls.

events.title: U.S. Services Index Edges Slightly Lower In October
events.description: Service sector growth in the U.S. saw a modest slowdown in the month of October, according to a report released by the Institute for Supply Management on Wednesday. The ISM said its services PMI edged down to 54.5 in October after dipping to 54.9 in September, although a reading above 50 still indicates growth. Economists had expected the index to slip to 54.7.

events.title: U.S. Private Sector Adds 86,000 Jobs In October, More Than Expected
events.description: Payroll processor ADP released a report on Wednesday showing private sector employment in the U.S. grew by more than expected in the month of October. The report said private sector employment climbed by 86,000 jobs in October, matching a downwardly revised increase in September.

events.title: U.S. Trade Deficit Unexpectedly Narrows To $105.0 Billion In September
events.description: With exports increasing by more than imports, the Commerce Department released a report on Wednesday showing the U.S. trade deficit unexpectedly shrank in the month of September.

events.title: CVS Health Swings To Q3 Profit, Lifts FY26 Outlook; To Split Into Two; Shares Drop
events.description: CVS Health Corp. reported Wednesday a profit in its third quarter, compared to prior year's loss, mainly on the absence of prior year's $5.7 billion goodwill impairment charge, and higher revenues. Further, the firm raised fiscal 2026 outlook to reflect increases in the Health Care Benefits and Pharmacy & Consumer Wellness segments. Separately, CVS Health announced its plan to separate into two.

events.title: Eurozone Private Sector Growth Moderates
events.description: The euro area private sector growth moderated to a four-month low in October as new order receipts came close to stalling and output price inflation remained historically high, final purchasing managers' survey data from S&P Global showed Wednesday. The final composite output index fell to 51.7 in October from 53.1 in the previous month. The flash reading was 51.9.

events.title: U.S. Private Sector Employment Increases More Than Expected In October
events.description: Payroll processor ADP released a report on Wednesday showing private sector employment in the U.S. grew by more than expected in the month of October.

events.title: Canadian Stocks Set To Open Firm On Global Gains, Metal Surge
events.description: Canadian equities expected to open higher Wednesday, supported by positive global markets, rising precious metals prices, and lower oil easing inflation concerns. Intact Financial reports 35% profit decline; Shopify earnings beat expectations.

events.title: Bank, Mining Stocks Lift FTSE 100
events.description: U.K. stocks moved higher on Wednesday as lower oil prices and softening bond yields aided sentiment. Investors also digested the latest batch of earnings updates and economic data, in addition to following the political news from the U.S. Mining and bank stocks led the move up north

events.title: Eurozone Inflation Accelerates To 3-Year High On Energy Prices
events.description: Eurozone inflation accelerated to a three-year high in October on energy prices, reinforcing expectations for another interest rate hike. Inflation increased to 4.0 percent in October from 3.8 percent in September, flash data from Eurostat showed Wednesday.
